headline: Public source repo and multiple recognized audits, but most recent dated audit (Certora, March 2025) is ~11 months before the latest release (v1.14.1, March 2026), and on-chain bytecode verification could not be confirmed this run
short_headline: Stale audit coverage; on-chain verify blocked

findings.text: Kamino Lend's core program ID is KLend2g3cP87fffoy8q1mQqGKjrxjC8boSyAYavgmjD on Solana mainnet (confirmed in the public klend README). On-chain bytecode verification status could not be confirmed this run: solscan.io, explorer.solana.com, and solana.fm all rejected fetch requests, and the DeFiPunkd read API does not support Solana (only EVM chainIds 1–534352). Solana uses its own program verification tooling (solana-verify / OtterSec verifier) distinct from EVM explorer source verification. Status recorded as unknown-this-run.

Public source repo https://github.com/Kamino-Finance/klend exists and is open-source (Rust 99.9%). The README explicitly maps the deployed program ID KLend2g3cP87fffoy8q1mQqGKjrxjC8boSyAYavgmjD to this repository. Latest release v1.14.1 was published March 5, 2026 with 51 total commits. No commit SHA was pinnable this run (GitHub commit-history pages returned access errors); the repo correspondence is established by the README program-ID mapping, not a bytecode diff.

The Kamino-Finance/audits repository lists the following klend-specific audit files: kamino_klend_sec3.pdf (sec3, scoped Dec 2024 per the sec3 reports index), kamino_lend_ottersec.pdf (OtterSec), kamino_lend_certora.pdf (Certora formal verification, blog post dated March 25, 2025), kamino_lend_ackee_blockchain_fuzz_tests.pdf (Ackee Blockchain fuzz tests), and kamino_lend_osec_formal_verification.pdf (OtterSec formal verification), plus kamino_lend_rx.pdf. The most recent datable audit is Certora (March 2025). The latest klend release (v1.14.1) was March 5, 2026 — approximately 11 months after the most recent known dated audit. No follow-up audit covering this post-March-2025 period was found.

Auditors covering klend include OtterSec, sec3, Certora (formal verification), and Ackee Blockchain — all recognized Solana/blockchain security firms. Certora is listed in the broadly-recognized firms in the rubric. OtterSec is a well-known Solana-focused security firm. Ackee Blockchain is also recognized. No unknown-firm audits in scope.

The klend repo had 51 commits total as of this fetch, with the latest release v1.14.1 on March 5, 2026. The most recent dated audit (Certora formal verification) was March 25, 2025 — approximately 11 months of potential post-audit code changes. The CoinMarketCap source notes a 'Fourth Formal Verification for Kamino Lend' dated October 10, 2025, which would cover drift through ~Oct 2025 and reduce the gap to ~5 months before the March 2026 release. However, that October 2025 audit was not directly verifiable from the fetched audits repo (no dated 4th Certora report was visible in the file listing), so it cannot be confirmed this run. Specific diff content was not accessible this run, so the nature of post-audit changes (material vs. non-material) cannot be assessed.

Solana programs use BPFLoaderUpgradeable rather than EVM proxy patterns. There is no separate proxy/implementation split in the EVM sense. Upgradeability is managed through the Solana upgrade authority mechanism. The klend program at KLend2g3cP87fffoy8q1mQqGKjrxjC8boSyAYavgmjD may or may not have a live upgrade authority; this could not be verified this run (all Solana explorer fetches failed).

steelman.red: On-chain bytecode verification could not be confirmed at all this run, and if the program is not verified via solana-verify or a similar tool, an outsider cannot independently confirm the deployed code matches the public repo.
steelman.orange: The public source repo exists with confirmed program-ID mapping, multiple recognized-firm audits cover klend, but the most recently datable audit (Certora, March 2025) precedes the current release (v1.14.1, March 2026) by ~11 months, placing it beyond the 6-month threshold; and on-chain bytecode verification status is unconfirmed this run.
steelman.green: Kamino has one of the deepest multi-firm audit stacks on Solana (OtterSec, sec3, Certora formal verification, Ackee Blockchain fuzz tests), the source code is fully public and repo-mapped to the deployed program ID, and a CoinMarketCap source references a fourth formal verification in October 2025 that would reduce the post-audit drift window to ~5 months before the latest release.

rationale.verdict: Choosing orange because: (1) the most recently confirmed dated audit (Certora, March 25, 2025) is ~11 months before the latest deployment release (v1.14.1, March 5, 2026), exceeding the 6-month stale threshold; (2) a potential October 2025 fourth formal verification was mentioned in a secondary source (CoinMarketCap) but was not directly verifiable from the fetched audits repo or audit PDFs this run, so it cannot be credited; (3) on-chain bytecode verification status (e.g., via solana-verify) could not be confirmed because all Solana explorer fetch attempts failed. The green steelman depends on confirming the October 2025 audit and on-chain verification — both remain unknowns. The red steelman is weaker than orange because the public repo, program-ID mapping, and multi-firm recognized audit history are well-established.

evidence.shows: Official klend source repo; README confirms mainnet program ID KLend2g3cP87fffoy8q1mQqGKjrxjC8boSyAYavgmjD, open-source Rust code, latest release v1.14.1 (March 5, 2026), 51 total commits.

Kamino's public audits repository listing all klend-related audit PDFs: kamino_klend_sec3.pdf, kamino_lend_ottersec.pdf, kamino_lend_certora.pdf, kamino_lend_ackee_blockchain_fuzz_tests.pdf, kamino_lend_osec_formal_verification.pdf, kamino_lend_rx.pdf. Also confirms Immunefi bug bounty.

Certora formal verification of Kamino Lending (KLend at KLend2g3cP87fffoy8q1mQqGKjrxjC8boSyAYavgmjD), blog post dated March 25, 2025. Confirms Certora as auditor, scope includes klend exchange rate / collateral redemption logic, identified and fixed precision loss bug.
sec3 public reports index confirms 'Kamino Scope' audit in December 2024 on Solana, establishing sec3 as a recognized auditor with a dated klend audit.

Next run should attempt https://verify.osec.io or solana.fm verification badge.
V1-offchain: All Solana block explorer fetch attempts failed; grading_basis set to mixed.

V2: No commit SHA was pinnable for the klend repo this run (GitHub commit history pages returned access errors). Source-repo correspondence established via program-ID README mapping only, not a bytecode diff.

V5: A 'Fourth Formal Verification for Kamino Lend' reportedly dated October 2025 was mentioned in a CoinMarketCap secondary source but could not be confirmed from the fetched audits repository or a directly fetched audit PDF. Next run should fetch kamino_lend_osec_formal_verification.pdf or kamino_vault_certora.pdf from the audits repo to verify date and scope.

protocol_metadata.about: Kamino Lend (KLend) is a lending protocol on Solana that allows users to deposit collateral and borrow liquidity against it, with markets for SOL, USDC, USDT, and other Solana assets. Users can also earn yield by supplying assets to lending pools. The protocol uses a collateral-share (cToken-equivalent) mechanism to represent deposited positions, with exchange rates determined by total liquidity and share supply. It is open-source under a Business Source License and has been audited by OtterSec, sec3, Certora (formal verification), and Ackee Blockchain.
